description: EU VAT number validation against the official VIES service: valid or invalid, registered name and address, an optional check of the name you expect and, if you give your own VAT number, a VIES consultation number to keep as audit evidence. Norwegian numbers are checked against the Norwegian VAT register. Use when: onboarding an EU supplier or customer, or before paying an invoice.

expect_name.description: the company name you expect; the answer says whether it matches the registered name (match, partial, mismatch or not_checked)

requester_vat.description: your own EU VAT number: VIES then issues a consultation number, proof of the check to keep as audit evidence (not for Norwegian numbers)

vat.description: the VAT number to check, with its country prefix (an EU member state, or NO for Norway), e.g. CZ45274649

name: vat
title: EU VAT number validation
